nodes.rationale: AIGate is the single entry point for AI calls so rate limits, cache lookup, usage logging, and provider fallback stay centralized.

nodes.label: Supabase Repository Layer
nodes.rationale: Database access is constrained to repositories so modules and routes do not call get_db directly.

nodes.label: Validation Contract
nodes.rationale: Evaluation only uses ChromaDB chunks that Supabase confirms as validated; otherwise the answer key is used with a warning.

nodes.label: Content Validation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Content must be validated before students use a chapter because unvalidated or misextracted chunks are excluded from student-visible evaluation context.

nodes.label: Flutter AppTheme
nodes.rationale: Web and Flutter keep separate design systems because their token layers and color palettes are explicitly unrelated.

nodes.label: Legal Document Sync Checklist
nodes.rationale: Canonical privacy and terms files must be mirrored to web and mobile render sources with legal last-updated constants changed together.

nodes.label: Legal Review Trigger Events
nodes.rationale: Listed business, data, distribution, entity, notice, and platform changes require legal review before proceeding.
